commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' The referee is firm and issues Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) a deserved yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Unai Simon makes a brilliant save! Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
88' Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
86' A yellow-coloured card is received by Marcao (Sevilla).
86' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
84' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
80' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Adria Pedrosa is replaced by Marcao (Sevilla).
80' Substitution. Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) replaces Nico Williams.

79' What an opportunity! Kike Salas (Sevilla) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
78' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Suso (Sevilla). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
76' 0 - 2 Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
75' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) receives a yellow card for infringement.
74' It's time for a substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) comes on in place of Mikel Vesga.
74' Substitution. Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Gorka Guruzeta.
73' One of the players from Sevilla times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Here is a change. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
69' The game has come to an end for Oihan Sancet. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
65' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' It will be a substitution. Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) is ready to enter the pitch as Juanlu Sanchez walks off.
65' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to make a change. Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) replaces Loic Bade.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Djibril Sow will be replaced by Oliver Torres (Sevilla).
64' The attendance is 28366.
62' Kike Salas (Sevilla) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
62' The referee signals a corner kick to Sevilla.
62' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
59' Marko Dmitrovic blocks Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao)'s effort from the edge of the box.
58' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but it's cleared.

58' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Suso (Sevilla) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
55' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
55' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Looks like Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
54' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) as his effort only hit the wall. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
53' Jose Maria Sanchez blows the whistle, Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Sevilla have a free kick from a promising distance.
51' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) but poses no threat.
49' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
47' Wasted opportunity. Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.

46' What a chance that is! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the crossbar!
46' Referee Jose Maria Sanchez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Ath Bilbao work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
44' Suso (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Unai Simon, who smothers the ball.
42' An accurate cross picks out Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
42' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
41' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make a change. Nemanja Gudelj is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla).
40' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
39' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
37' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
36' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
36' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Djibril Sow (Sevilla) gets booked.
34' The ratio of the ball possession is 55:45.

30' 0 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta finds Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Marko Dmitrovic had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
29' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Maria Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
26' A lofted cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
25' What a huge chance for Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
23' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

23' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
20' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) causes Marko Dmitrovic little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
17' Suso (Sevilla) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
16' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
15' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
8' Ath Bilbao are seeing far more of the ball now.
4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
4' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Maria Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Marko Dmitrovic easily deals with the threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Jose Maria Sanchez will referee today's match.
